comparison.objective: Unzip a soft pencil case, insert markers, and zip it closed; setup and scoring are missing.
comparison.physical_skill: Zipper manipulation and flexible-container packing rather than hex-key seating, collar tuning, and force-limited setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Markers enclosed in a re-zipped case versus quantitatively acceptable damper cycles and post-lock drift tolerance.
comparison.reason: Opening/packing/closing a soft container tests different mechanics and outcomes from commissioning an adjustable energy absorber.
